name: Lobras (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and red in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Lobras (a tree, a wolf and a chalice).
history: Municipal flag of Lobras; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Lobras arms — tree, wolf and chalice
